If "shutdown Target" is ECUM_ SHUTDOWN_ TARGET_ RESET, sleep Mode tells which of the configured reset modes w as actually chosen. Return value Std _ - Return - Type E_ OK: The service has succeeded E_ NOT_ OK: The service has failed, e.g. due to NULL pointer being passed Description Ecu M_ Get Shutdown Target returns the currently selected shutdown target as set by Ecu M_ Select Shutdown Target. Ecu M_ Get Shutdown Target is part of the ECU Manager Module port interface. Available via Ecu M.h
